All forge runs and medusa adversarial run-2 use the fixed harness.

strategy's own sub-dust delivery rounds to 0 at the router -> 'Received nothing' revert; no griefer needed. Already stated in CODE-002 attackVector ('Same failure occurs without any griefer...').

sequence: act_setYield(0, <large USDe>, 27317)  // deliverBps ~ 10,315 (USDe delivers ~3% over estimate)
counterexample.result: SYA safeTransferFrom reverts ERC20InsufficientAllowance(sya, owed, payment) (e.g. 11322358372 < 11899030467). Tripwire refinement: the 1% buffer is applied to the AGGREGATE estimate, so a +2% DOLA over-delivery is absorbed in a full claim (1545.3 borrowed vs 1539 paid) but reverts in a DOLA-only claim (454.5 vs 459).

failures.sharpening: Exposure is largest exactly when the caller exempts the over-estimating strategies (USDe 75%, USDC 99%) and leaves DOLA (100% exact on fork) alone - the operator's natural reaction to other failures removes the headroom.
